steps.content: The entire defense grid is pushed to its limits, glowing with a pulsating blue light, intermittently shattered by the savage Mania tempests.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The Black Ring pollution is rapidly expanding, hitting a tipping point. The amassed Mania energy is violently bursting forth, causing the edges of the Black Ring to expand at an alarming rate!

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Defense Line!! Crank up the power to the max, we've got to stop it!!

Rusty iron pillars, tainted and crumbling, materialize from above, their oozing contamination sinking into Syndicate's shattered ruins like slow-moving spikes. The crowd is in a panic, screaming and fleeing in every direction, but shadows stand firm, fighting back with all they've got.
Yet, in comparison to its surroundings, the shadows seem strikingly fragile.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Turn around! Head back now! Find cover underground and stay hidden!!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Damn it! This is all the shadows I've got... I can't keep all these people safe.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: The Mania inside the injured has spiraled out of control. We've run out of Hypercubes, and even the sedatives aren't working anymore. Lavina! Lavina, where are you? Hurry back!

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Lavina?!
At last, he finds his guardian angel, but the woman who'd been his rock is already down. Black spikes of light pierce through her, but beneath her, she continues to protect a terrified, wounded ally.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Are these... shackles? How did they get so severe? You've been bearing this burden all along, yet still protecting others even till now...

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Sob... We've got shelters that are still operational, and there are people who can help. I'll get you there, I'll lead everyone to refuge, I... I'll do everything I can...
The Secret Ward Overwhelmed by Contamination

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, please, I'm begging you, wake up!
She scrambles to apply the White Cube to ${PlayerName}'s chest, while she keeps getting scorched by the unyielding contamination.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Why isn't this working? Wasn't it supposed to stop the contamination, to save people?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is it because I'm not strong enough, or did I mess up something earlier?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, please, I need you to wake up, or I can't do anything...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Please, I'm begging you... come on... wake up...
The contamination creeps onto the girl, slowly fading her into unconsciousness as she slumps in front of ${PlayerName}, engulfed in contamination. The White Cube drops to the floor.
Everything is too late. It couldn't do what it was supposed to.
The maze crafted from contamination is gradually falling apart, melting and reshaping into more recognizable monsters. The man sprawled on the ground quietly observes it all.
His life is drawing to a close, but in this moment, he experiences an unmatched feeling of fulfillment and pride.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Nurturing of the Black Rings never relied on some Underground sorceries. Mania is the emotion, the Ring is the connection, and naturally, only the human heart can cultivate them.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Such fertile ground, filled with hate, fear, anger, despair... But more importantly, it's about unleashing all these burgeoning passions. They refuse to be silenced, and thus, they are powerful.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Here lies both glory and sin, untamed and unbound. This Black Ring is Syndicate itself.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Thanks for the nudge from Paradeisos. Next up... it's time to race.

His body deteriorates further, his mind growing foggy. The slow, deliberate footsteps from below grow closer. The unmistakable aura of death advances on him. With the last of his energy, Parma manages to muster his iconic smile.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Ah, yes, I am quite satisfied.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: I have fulfilled my duties, ensnared those destined for demise, and meticulously paved the paths foreordained... I believe it's time for me to end this.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: I am... deeply satisfied.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: The rest is in your hands.
Bang—Bang Bang Bang!
Her silver spear completely obliterates the Underground agent's last physical form. The woman's final rounds sink deep into the earth. Her hat dips low, obscuring her face.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: ...Marta, Red J, Padron, Viper, Azure... your mission's accomplished, nicely done.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Take a rest, no more late nights for you.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Next...
She looks toward the boiling Black Ring. There, at the edge, someone else is still battling, about to be swallowed by the widening halo.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Over here!

A lone figure breaks free from the monsters' suffocating embrace, with erratic bolts of lightning springing from him, boiling, pulsating. They merge into a fierce, blinding golden spear that cleaves the heavens. A cacophony of thunder crashes down, the tempest tearing apart the monsters' tidal onslaught, briefly hindering the Black Ring's advance.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Stay sharp, this battle isn't done yet—I'm still standing, and ready to take you on!

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: All for the sake of that person, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Hmph!
A forest of razor-sharp, rusted rebars erupt from the ground, lunging at Donald, ensnaring him in a makeshift iron cage, trapping his frantic struggles.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: It's all over—the Ring's gained too much power, the White Cube is no match for it now. The entire West District is feeding on its strength. This time, it's unbeatable—not by Paradeisos, not by the Underground, not by that person either, and certainly not by you...

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: It's always the same with you, always a step behind, too late to make a difference.

The Corpseborne inches closer to Donald. The deadly steel rebars constrict, stealing his breath, while filth and rust creep from the iron frame, eating into his flesh. As his awareness blurs, he senses the monster looming over him, about to shred and flatten him any moment now.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: What I failed to do 9 years ago still eludes me today.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: But bear in mind... this time, it was my choice to embrace the Black Ring, and it will surely bring to life... my deepest desire.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Your... desire?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You are...?
Donald feels a flicker of hope. He lifts his head and sees the Corpseborne, bearing Julien's face, watching him calmly.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: Next, it's your turn.
His words are cut short as an overwhelming blast hits him, forcefully ejecting him from the Ring's domain.
(Transition)
You swing open the last gate of the maze, greeted by the sight of that well-known lookout.
No sign of Julien here; it's eerily quiet, with not a soul around. Just a lone wheelchair resting quietly against the lookout's edge, with a mug of lukewarm coffee perched on it.
Off in the distance, the white maze begins to stain a deep red, morphing into the world you're all too familiar with. You can even hear someone frantically calling your name.
The red glow is closing in on you, making you feel like you're just moments away from reaching that other world, and you'll be leaving here. But just before you do—
You take a sip, guessing it's prepared with the architect's beloved ten sugar cubes. It's perfectly sweet, just sweet enough for you to feel a hint of flavor, under the circumstances.
The red halo shatters its bonds, swelling quickly in size. Outside it, the polluted maze contorts, spreading like a starving creature, engulfing everything on its way.

The tower lets out a thunderous boom, resonating with everyone in West District, be they Overground or Underground, commoners or Sinners. After eight months since it resurfaced, the Second Black Ring is finally completely unleashed.
Deep in the secret room beneath Drifter Camp, the girl is entirely unconscious, her limp body gradually slipping off the nursing stand.
—Right when Hecate is on the verge of collapsing to the ground, a hand catches her.
